name: Lavender Town & Tower Recon
summary: Emerging from the southern exit of Rock Tunnel into the eerie tranquility of Lavender Town. Visit the Volunteer Pokémon House to learn that elder Mr. Fuji has gone missing inside Pokémon Tower. The upper floors of the tower are veiled in unidentifiable ghosts that require the Silph Scope from Celadon City.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.method: Behind the Pokémon Tower entrance in the small fenced alcove

items.name: Sun Stone
items.method: Inside the Volunteer Pokémon House on the lower table

items.name: TM41 Torment
items.method: Given by the girl outside the Name Rater's house
